info.title: UniFi Public API
info.description: Production API operations organized around the UniFi payment lifecycle. Internal administration, worker, dashboard, support, scheduling, and Falcon orchestration routes are intentionally excluded.

get.description: Returns the current health of the API.

200.description: The API is healthy.

get.summary: Get API credits and key summaries
get.description: Returns the API plan, remaining credits, and key summaries for the account that owns the bearer API key. Each call costs one API credit. Check `data.metadata.credits` periodically or before a batch and alert your agents when the balance falls below your threshold so they can pause or defer work.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: UniFi user ID of the account that owns the bearer API key.

200.description: The API plan, credit balance after the charge, and key names and creation times.

400.description: The API key is invalid or the account has exhausted its API credits.

get.summary: Get a wallet address for a chain
get.description: Resolves the user's wallet address for the requested chain.

200.description: An EVM wallet address.

get.description: Returns the user's wallet address for every supported chain protocol.

200.description: Wallet addresses keyed by protocol.

get.description: Returns the formatted net balance for one user, chain, and stablecoin.

200.description: Human-readable token balance.

get.summary: Get all stablecoin balances on a chain
get.description: Returns formatted balances for every supported stablecoin on the requested chain.

200.description: Stablecoin balances keyed by ticker.

get.summary: Get the complete wallet balance view
get.description: Returns all supported assets across all supported chains, ordered by total USD value.

200.description: The aggregate wallet balance view.

get.summary: Get latest and finalized wallet balances for one pair
get.description: Returns comparable latest-block and finalized-block net balances for one stablecoin-chain pair. Both use the same pay formula so `finality_status` and `finality_delta` describe only the exact block-finality difference. The `balance` field remains the two-decimal latest-block balance, while `latest_value_usd` is its two-decimal USD value.

200.description: The selected pair's latest and finalized wallet balances.

get.description: Returns each supported stablecoin balance and USD value for one chain.

200.description: Wallet balances grouped by stablecoin.

get.description: Returns the selected stablecoin's balance and USD value across supported chains.

200.description: Wallet balances grouped by chain.

get.description: Returns the user's formatted net balance before creating a payment.

200.description: Spendable stablecoin balance.

get.description: Returns the formatted estimated total stablecoin fee for the selected route.

200.description: Estimated fee denominated in the selected stablecoin.

get.description: Combines spendable balance, estimated fee, and allowance state for the selected route.

200.description: Payment preflight values.

post.description: Returns balances, BundlePay allowances, gas data, and prices for the selected stablecoins on one chain.

200.description: Raw custodial inputs for the selected stablecoins.

post.description: Checks the sender balance and Permit2 allowance, then estimates the payment fee for one self-custodial payment.

200.description: The balance, allowance, and estimated fee required for the payment.

post.description: Checks balances and Permit2 allowances by coin, then estimates the total fee for a self-custodial bulk payment.

200.description: Balances and allowances by coin, plus the total estimated fee.

get.description: Returns raw allowance, balance, gas, and price inputs for client-side self-custodial payment calculations.

200.description: The raw inputs used to calculate balance and fee requirements.

post.description: Returns raw Permit2 allowances, balances, gas data, and prices for the selected stablecoins on one chain.

200.description: Raw self-custodial inputs for the selected stablecoins.

post.description: Submits a payment from a UniFi-managed wallet. The response is a receipt ID; query the receipt endpoint for settlement progress.

200.description: The new receipt ID.

post.description: Submits two or more same-chain payments from a UniFi-managed wallet. UniFi handles controlled-wallet approval and signing and returns one durable bulk payment ID plus one receipt ID per recipient.

200.description: The bulk payment ID and receipt IDs created for the batch.

post.description: Submits a merchant payment from a UniFi-managed wallet and associates its receipt with the supplied payment session. A session accepts only one payment; an already-paid or currently-processing session returns `409 Conflict`.

200.description: The new receipt ID.

post.description: Builds the EIP-712 domain and Permit2 message that the sender signs before submitting one self-custodial payment.

200.description: The EIP-712 domain and Permit2 message to sign.

post.description: Builds the EIP-712 domain and Permit2 message that the sender signs before submitting a self-custodial bulk payment.

200.description: The EIP-712 domain and Permit2 message to sign.

post.description: Submits one payment with the sender's Permit2 nonce and signature. The response is a receipt ID; query the receipt endpoint for settlement progress.

200.description: The new receipt ID.

post.description: Submits a signed Permit2 batch and returns one durable bulk payment ID plus the receipt IDs created for its individual payments.

200.description: The bulk payment ID and receipt IDs created for the batch.

post.description: Submits a signed self-custodial merchant payment and associates its receipt with the supplied payment session. A session accepts only one payment; an already-paid or currently-processing session returns `409 Conflict`.

200.description: The new receipt ID.

get.summary: Get a merchant payment session status
get.description: Returns the receipt ID associated with a merchant payment session. An empty `data` string means that no receipt has been attached yet.

200.description: The associated receipt ID, or an empty string while the session is waiting for payment.

get.description: Returns the latest known state of one stablecoin payment.

200.description: The payment receipt.

get.description: Returns the ordered individual receipts created by one managed-wallet or self-custodial bulk-payment submission.

200.description: The bulk payment and its individual receipts.

get.description: Returns a page of receipts sent or received by the user. `pending=true` matches `Processing` and `Confirmed` receipts; `pending=false` excludes both. Do not combine `pending` with `status`. For a continuation request, set `next_or_previous` and pass the receipt ID at the current page edge as `cursor`: the last receipt for the next page or the first receipt for the previous page.

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: Filter by chain.

parameters.name: coin
parameters.description: Filter by stablecoin.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by receipt state.

parameters.name: pending
parameters.description: true matches Processing and Confirmed; false excludes both. Cannot be combined with status.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Filter by payments sent or received by the user.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of receipts to return.

parameters.name: next_or_previous
parameters.description: true requests the next page; false requests the previous page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Receipt ID at the current page edge. Required for stateless continuation requests; use the last receipt ID for next and the first receipt ID for previous.

200.description: A page of payment receipts.

get.description: Returns saved contacts in name order. Set `with_batch=true` to include batch memberships and an independent batch page. Contact filters apply only to the contacts page.

parameters.name: with_batch
parameters.description: Include batch_ids on each contact and a separately paginated batch list in data.batches.

parameters.name: protocol
parameters.description: Filter by chain protocol.

parameters.name: is_own_wallet
parameters.description: Use true for contacts marked as the user's own wallets or false for other recipients.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Filter by a case-insensitive substring of the contact name.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Use data.next_cursor from the previous contacts page with the same filters.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of contacts per page. The API clamps the value to 1–100.

parameters.name: batch_cursor
parameters.description: Use data.batches.next_cursor from the previous batch page. Used when with_batch=true.

parameters.name: batch_limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of batches per page when with_batch=true. The API clamps the value to 1–100.

200.description: A page of contacts and, when requested, a page of batches.

post.description: Creates and updates contacts in one request. Existing protocol/address pairs are left as saved unless `reject_existing` is `true`, which returns a conflict. To save a batch, set `save_batch=true` and provide at least two distinct members across saved IDs and submitted contacts. Include `batch_id` to replace a batch's full membership and name.

200.description: The resolved contacts and optional saved batch.

example.message: Contacts and optional batch upserted successfully

delete.description: Deletes the selected contacts and updates their batch memberships in one operation. Batches that would have fewer than two members or duplicate a retained batch are deleted. Preview the batch changes before sending this request.

200.description: The deleted contact IDs and resulting batch changes.

get.description: Returns a saved contact and all of its batch memberships.

parameters.name: contact_id
parameters.description: Contact ID returned by the contacts API.

200.description: The contact and its batch IDs.

post.description: Returns the batches that would be deleted or have members removed if the selected contacts were deleted. This is a read-only preview.

200.description: The contact IDs and projected batch changes.

get.description: Returns a page of saved batches, newest first, with the full contact records for each batch. Contact records include all their batch memberships.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Use the next_cursor from the previous batch page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of batches per page. The API clamps the value to 1–100.

200.description: A page of batches with their contacts.

get.description: Returns one saved batch and its member contact IDs.

parameters.name: batch_id
parameters.description: Batch ID returned by the contacts API.

200.description: The batch and its member IDs.

delete.description: Deletes a batch. Set `del_its_contacts=true` to also delete its contacts and reconcile all other batches that contain them.

parameters.name: batch_id
parameters.description: Batch ID returned by the contacts API.

200.description: The batch was removed.
